assessment: Peña-Ramos et al., describe a novel interaction between phagosomes and autophagosomes in the degradation of apoptotic cell corpses. Using time-lapse fluorescence microscopy to measure dynamic changes in phagosomes, as well as electron microscopy, the authors follow cell corpse degradation in specific phagocytic cells of developing C. elegans embryos. They find that autophagosomes attach to phagosomes and promote their degradation by controlling acidification. The study uncovers a novel function of autophagosomes, and presents a new paradigm for how cell corpses are degraded.
